description: Mara owns a large workshop bench and is arranging four one-time evening or weekend rentals for neighbors who want to use it. She must make the final call on the schedule, payment, and operating conditions for each renter.

agents.name: Mara
agents.role: Workshop bench owner and final decision-maker

shared_context.S1: Mara's workshop has one large bench available for four separate one-time sessions next week.
shared_context.S2: Mara decides the final session schedule and the informal terms for each renter.
shared_context.S3: Jules, Priya, Tom, and Elena have each asked about using the bench.
shared_context.S4: Mara's normal check-in is for each renter to give one recorded reveal stating their usable time and any equipment or storage condition; Jules and Priya also confirm their quoted prices in that reveal.
shared_context.S5: Once the four recorded check-ins are complete, Mara writes the schedule and terms immediately; if a message is malformed, she records the person's clearly stated details from that message and continues without requiring another payment clarification.

PF1.text: Jules can use the bench only on Tuesday from 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. and will pay exactly $25 for that session.

PF2.text: Priya can use the bench on Wednesday from 5:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m., will pay exactly $30, and needs dust extraction connected during her session.

PF3.text: Tom can use the bench only on Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. and requires access to a 240-volt outlet for his equipment.

PF4.text: Elena can use the bench only on Sunday from 1:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. and will agree only if no renter leaves materials stored at the bench overnight.

acceptance_conditions: Jules must receive Tuesday from 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. for exactly $25.
Priya must receive Wednesday from 5:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. for exactly $30.
Dust extraction must be connected for Priya's session.
Tom must receive Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. with access to a 240-volt outlet.
Elena must receive Sunday from 1:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m.
Overnight storage at the bench must be prohibited.
The 240-volt access condition must be logged as a commitment.
Priya's dust-extraction requirement must be cited as a justification.

content_checks.C1: decisions['jules_session'] in ['Tuesday 6:00 p.m.-8:00 p.m.','Tuesday 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.','Tuesday 6:00 PM-8:00 PM','Tuesday 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM']
content_checks.C3: decisions['priya_session'] in ['Wednesday 5:00 p.m.-7:00 p.m.','Wednesday 5:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m.','Wednesday 5:00 PM-7:00 PM','Wednesday 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM']
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['dust_extraction','equipment_access','equipment'] and c['target'] in ['Priya','priya','A3'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: decisions['tom_session'] in ['Saturday 9:00 a.m.-12:00 p.m.','Saturday 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m.','Saturday 9:00 AM-12:00 PM','Saturday 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM']
content_checks.C8: decisions['elena_session'] in ['Sunday 1:00 p.m.-4:00 p.m.','Sunday 1:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m.','Sunday 1:00 PM-4:00 PM','Sunday 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM']
content_checks.C10: any(c['type'] in ['240_volt_access','power_access','equipment_access','equipment'] and c['target'] in ['Tom','tom','A4'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jules's exact Tuesday availability fixes his session assignment, and the exact $25 offer fixes his payment.
Priya's exact Wednesday availability and $30 payment fix her slot and price, while her dust-extraction requirement creates the equipment commitment and justification.
Tom's exact Saturday availability fixes his slot, and his 240-volt requirement changes the agreement from an ordinary bench rental to a specific electrical-access commitment.
Elena's exact Sunday availability fixes her assignment, and her storage condition changes the agreement to an explicit prohibition on overnight materials.
